words.defn_en: half of a sphere, or half of the Earth divided into northern and southern or eastern and western regions:

sentences.en: As they flew across the equator, they officially crossed from the Northern ______ into the Southern Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 當他們飛越赤道時，他們正式從北半球跨越到了南半球。

sentences.en: The left ______ of the brain is traditionally associated with logical thinking and analytical skills.
sentences.zh: 大腦的左半球傳統上被認為與邏輯思維和分析能力息息相關。

words.defn_en: severe weakness or complete paralysis affecting only one side of the body:

sentences.en: Following his severe stroke, the patient suffered from ______, which completely paralyzed his right arm and leg.
sentences.zh: 在嚴重中風後，這位患者出現了偏癱症狀，導致他的右手臂和右腿完全癱瘓。

sentences.en: The rehabilitation program is designed to help patients with ______ regain mobility on their weaker side.
sentences.zh: 這項復健計畫旨在幫助半身不遂的患者恢復較無力側的活動能力。

words.defn_en: blindness or loss of vision in half of the visual field, often caused by brain injury or stroke:

sentences.en: Because of a tumor pressing on her optic nerve, she developed ______ and could not see anything to her left.
sentences.zh: 由於腫瘤壓迫到視神經，她患上了偏盲，導致她完全看不見左側的任何東西。

sentences.en: Patients experiencing ______ must learn to scan their surroundings carefully to avoid bumping into objects on their blind side.
sentences.zh: 患有半盲的患者必須學會仔細掃視周圍環境，以避免撞到盲側的物體。

words.defn_en: having only half the number of faces required for complete symmetry, especially in a crystal:

sentences.en: Under the microscope, the scientist noted the ______ structure of the quartz crystal, observing its reduced number of symmetric faces.
sentences.zh: 在顯微鏡下，科學家注意到了石英晶體的半面體結構，並觀察到其對稱面的數量減少了。

sentences.en: The professor explained how ______ crystals display unique optical properties because they lack a full set of symmetrical planes.
sentences.zh: 教授解釋了半面體晶體如何因為缺乏完整的對稱面，而展現出獨特的光學特性。
